execution_surface.head: Head ·
execution_surface.project_defaults_hint: The assignee selects the topology; this project supplies progression, Squad concurrency, and review defaults.
execution_surface.strategy_hint: Automatic uses the issue owner and squad capabilities. Solo keeps one worker; Squad fans independent specialties out in parallel.
execution_surface.squad_hint: The selected squad's leader coordinates its capability roster.
execution_surface.squad_empty_hint: Create a squad with a leader and agent members before using Squad mode.
execution_surface.progression_hint: Gated pauses only at declared approvals. Manual pauses before each newly-ready batch.
execution_surface.model_routing_hint: Planning always gets frontier reasoning. Adaptive modes pin cheaper or stronger models per later step and record why.
execution_surface.parallel_workers_hint: Agora bounds this cap to distinct agents in the generated plan
execution_surface.review_plan_first: Review the proposed plan before it runs
execution_surface.create_failed: Could not create the execution plan
execution_surface.proposal_edit_hint: Review ownership before starting. Route changes create a new plan version; capability and readiness are checked by Agora.
execution_surface.action_failed_hint: This step could not finish. Open Details to review the technical error or retry it.
execution_surface.action_question_hint: Answer the agent's blocking question to continue this same work unit.
execution_surface.action_conflicts: The integrated result has conflicts that need a resolver.
execution_surface.action_stopped: This branch stopped before completing its handoff.
execution_surface.response_placeholder: Write the decision or missing context…

live_editor.idle_hint: Ask the agent to build or change something above — you'll watch it work here, live.
live_editor.comment_placeholder: Comment for the agent and team — posts to the issue…

slice_actions.no_agent_hint: Assign an agent (or set yourself one) to hand off AI actions. Use the Assignee picker above.
slice_actions.toast_fired: AI action sent — the draft will appear in the execution log.

qa_evidence.empty_hint: Run QA to generate a deterministic verdict.
qa_evidence.failure_summary: At least one expected behavior did not match the tested result.
qa_evidence.pass_summary: The tested behaviors matched their expected results.
qa_evidence.check_required_file: Required file has the expected content
qa_evidence.introduced_failure: This worked before the change but fails in the tested result.
qa_evidence.expected_file_present: The required file is present and contains the requested content.
qa_evidence.expected_check_pass: The behavior completes without an error.
qa_evidence.observed_file_missing: The required file was not present in the tested result.
qa_evidence.observed_timeout: The check did not finish in time.
qa_evidence.observed_failed: The tested behavior did not produce the expected result.
qa_evidence.test_cases_description: Named behaviors from the issue requirements. Open any row to see the expected and observed result.
qa_evidence.observed_not_run: This test case has not run yet.
qa_evidence.no_named_cases: No named test cases were recorded
qa_evidence.no_named_cases_hint: This run contains automated checks, but they are not linked to requirement-based test cases.

qa_review.live_preview_open_tab: No live browser on this host — open the QA target in a new tab.
qa_review.live_preview_not_embeddable: This environment blocks embedding — open it in a new tab instead.
qa_review.live_browser_hint: Reproduce or sanity-check directly against the running app
qa_review.live_browser_unavailable: No QA target is configured yet. Use Product to inspect the exact integration artifact.
qa_review.live_idle_hint: Most QA doesn't need a browser — open this to watch or drive the running app.
qa_review.run_regression_fired: Whole-branch regression fired against the sprint
qa_review.design_skipped_reason: Figma was unreachable — design comparison skipped (does not fail the gate).
qa_review.sent_back: Sent back to dev (qa:fail, in progress)
qa_review.note_ph: Repro steps / rationale — posted as a comment on send-back and pre-fills a filed bug
qa_review.send_back_dialog_desc: Add repro steps or rationale — posted as a comment and moves the issue back to In Progress.
qa_review.override_dialog_desc: Recorded with your name as the current QA verdict — on the evidence row and as a timeline comment.
qa_review.override_reason_ph: Why you're overriding — what you verified or what the agent got wrong

qa_bug.no_evidence: No failing checks captured — filing from the ticket.
qa_bug.notes_ph: Your own repro / rationale — merged with the evidence above into the bug description

test_cases.suggest_text: Let the QA agent derive cases from this ticket's acceptance criteria and description.
test_cases.empty_hint: Add one, or let the QA Squad generate them from the ticket.
test_cases.generated_toast: QA agent is writing test cases…
test_cases.rerun_failed_title: Re-run ONLY the currently-failing cases via the QA agent
test_cases.file_bug_case: File a bug from this case
test_cases.run_all_toast: QA agent is running the automated cases…
test_cases.flaky_title: Passed AND failed on the same commit in recent runs — treat the latest verdict with suspicion

qa_cockpit.release_command_ready: All active sprints are ready to ship
qa_cockpit.queue_empty_go_ship: The review queue is clear — check sprint readiness in Ship
qa_cockpit.queue_load_failed: Couldn't load the review queue — check your connection and try again.
qa_cockpit.lane_fail_subtitle: Failed QA — fix now or move to next sprint
qa_cockpit.lane_pending_subtitle: in review — awaiting or running QA
qa_cockpit.summary_all: The review queue across all projects, by QA verdict. {{count}} in review
qa_cockpit.summary_project: The review queue for {{project}}, by QA verdict. {{count}} in review
qa_cockpit.assignee_filter_empty: No assignees in the current queue.
qa_cockpit.state_running_title: A QA gate is executing on this issue now
qa_cockpit.state_stale_title: The QA gate never produced a verdict (agent died / never dispatched) — re-run QA
qa_cockpit.state_fail_title: QA failed — hotfix in this sprint (re-QA runs on re-review) or move it out
qa_cockpit.state_pending_title: In review — queued for or awaiting QA
qa_cockpit.state_blocked_title: The QA gate is deliberately blocked (e.g. an undeployable branch) — not a test failure
qa_cockpit.bugs_lane_open_subtitle: filed from a failed verdict — awaiting triage
qa_cockpit.bugs_lane_progress_subtitle: being fixed — re-QA runs on re-review
qa_cockpit.bugs_lane_fixed_subtitle: Done and passed — the repro is closed for real
qa_cockpit.bugs_empty_hint: Bugs filed from a failed QA verdict land here, tracked from open through in progress to verified fixed.
qa_cockpit.suite_select_project: Select a project to manage its regression suite.
qa_cockpit.suite_select_project_hint: The base suite is per-project — the standing golden-path cases that gate every release.
qa_cockpit.suite_description: The standing golden-path cases for this project — injected into every QA run and re-checked whole-branch at sprint end. A failing case here is a regression that stops the release.
qa_cockpit.suite_build_title: Fire the QA lead to author the base suite from the project's QA manifest
qa_cockpit.suite_empty_hint: The base suite is the standing release gate for this project — the golden paths every QA run must still pass. Build it from the QA manifest, or add cases by hand.
qa_cockpit.suite_toast_build_queued: Base-suite authoring queued — the QA lead is drafting cases from the QA manifest.
qa_cockpit.suite_archive_title: Archive this case (removes it from the standing suite)
qa_cockpit.sprint_empty: No active sprints. Sprint readiness appears here once a project has an active sprint.
qa_cockpit.sprint_description: Is each active sprint ready to ship? Every task on the shared sprint branch, by QA verdict — the human pass/fail plus the automated regression runs. A sprint is ready when every task passed and none is failing or pending.
qa_cockpit.sprint_confirm_move_title: Move this task to this sprint?
qa_cockpit.sprint_confirm_move_body: This task already belongs to sprint "{{name}}". Attaching it here moves it out of that sprint — its regression scope and rollup move too.
qa_cockpit.sprint_attach_modal_desc: Add a task from {{project}} to {{sprint}} for regression coverage.
qa_cockpit.metrics_description: Regression health across the workspace (last 30 days). Compiled scripts run deterministically in seconds; the rest are LLM-driven — the script coverage below is how much of QA has crossed to the fast path.
qa_cockpit.metrics_agent_speed_empty: No completed QA agent runs yet.
qa_cockpit.filter_stale_title: Only issues whose QA verdict no longer applies (gate stalled, or the code moved past the tested commit)
qa_cockpit.filter_needs_human_title: Only issues where a human decision is next: failed, or passed with failing cases
qa_cockpit.suite_flaky_filter_title: Show only flaky cases — both verdicts on the same commit in recent runs
qa_cockpit.ship_help: A sprint ships when every task has passed and none is failing or pending.

review_lens.no_review_plan_body: The result appears here when the execution plan's review step completes.
review_lens.no_reviewer_body: No agent could be resolved to review this issue distinct from its author. Pick a reviewer explicitly, or add this agent to a squad.
review_lens.stale_hint: The PR changed after this review — re-run it before approving.
review_lens.approve_confirm_body: Approve this exact reviewed artifact and start the persisted release worker?
review_lens.changes_note_placeholder: What must change before this can merge?
review_lens.changes_note_required: A note is required to request changes
review_lens.correction_requires_plan: Request changes requires an active execution plan.

review_lens.toast_approved_manual: Approved — merge it by hand (no squad lead to dispatch to)

review_lens.toast_release_started: Release approved — the merge worker started

review_lens.release_waiting_for_gates: Release unlocks after QA and review complete.

review_lens.blocked_qa_stale: The QA verdict is stale — re-run QA before review.
